component.name: BingoCaller
component.description: Bingo number caller with a big-screen display (slideshow background, scrolling banner, sponsor logos, multi-monitor). Offline .NET 8 WinForms desktop application.

components.name: Microsoft .NET 8 Desktop Runtime (Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App)
components.description: Runtime required to run the application. NOT bundled: installed separately by the user (the installer checks for it and points to the Microsoft download page).

components.name: Microsoft Windows (GDI/GDI+: gdi32.dll, msimg32.dll)
components.description: System imaging and drawing libraries called by the application (image decoding via GDI+, blitting via gdi32/msimg32). Provided and updated by Windows; not bundled.
